payload.name: There Is No Skip: Fix It or Pause and Retry
payload.description: A failure is fixed, or the work pauses at that point and retries. Nothing records a failure and moves on, and nothing substitutes a thinner result for the real one.

principles.name: There is no skip
principles.description: A recorded failure that the work walks past is a hidden loss. The work either succeeds or waits.

principles.name: Waiting is visible
principles.description: A paused or retrying item is shown to the operator with its reason; silence is never the way a failure is handled.

heuristics.condition: code logs a failure and then continues
heuristics.action: treat it as a defect: return the error so the work pauses and its resume retries

heuristics.condition: a fallback value or a thinner substitute stands in for a failed read or call
heuristics.action: remove the substitute and surface the failure

decision_rules.name: Fix or pause and retry
decision_rules.condition: a step, read, write or call fails
decision_rules.outcome: fix the cause, or pause the task at that step and retry with spacing that grows but never gives up; never record the failure and move on

decision_rules.name: No thinner substitute
decision_rules.condition: a real read or analysis fails and a lesser stand-in exists, such as a short preview, text instead of the graph, or a default
decision_rules.outcome: do not substitute; pause and retry the real work

decision_rules.name: Retry per item
decision_rules.condition: one item among many fails, such as a file, a candidate or a gap
decision_rules.outcome: re-queue that item with growing spacing until it succeeds; one failing item never blocks the others and never ends the run

decision_rules.name: Name the real exceptions
decision_rules.condition: a path appears to skip on purpose
decision_rules.outcome: allow it only when it is an operator-gated decision, an operator-set kill switch, a privacy withholding with a recorded reason, a removal gate that takes no action without evidence, or a resource that no longer exists and resumes by itself when it returns; list each exception where it occurs

decision_rules.name: Corrupt data is an error, not a loop
decision_rules.condition: a failure is data no retry can change
decision_rules.outcome: surface it to the operator as an error with its location instead of retrying forever in silence

decision_rules.name: Retire the old failure path
decision_rules.condition: a skip is replaced by pause and retry
decision_rules.outcome: remove the machinery that recorded the failure for later, and cite what superseded it
